Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Tiger of the Seven Seas" was released earlier than "My Wife's Lodger." This was a critical error in interpreting the information gathered by the WebSurfer. The Planner confused the release dates of the two films, swapping them in the final analysis. "My Wife's Lodger" was actually released in October 1952 in the United Kingdom, which is earlier than "Tiger of the Seven Seas," released on December 23, 1962, in Italy. This mistake directly impacted the final solution to the problem.
